_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_Jukebox/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_Jukebox/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Checked against the code 2026-09-27: the music, its tags and art never leave the device; sign-in (@unisim/sdk) is optional — password, emailed code, or Apple/Google/Microsoft; while signed in, one session.opened usage event per launch. The suite user count (@unisim/sdk presence.js) sends a random install id the app makes itself and the platform when the app opens and every 45 s in use, signed in or not, plus the account id once signed in: App interactions + Device or other IDs, required, Analytics (as Ergo Assess and Universal QR; brought in line 2026-10-10). The three lookups (lrclib.net, Wikipedia, iTunes Search) go straight from the phone to those services and are not collected by us. Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
